Class FaceppFacesetOperations

java.lang.Object
com.faceplusplus.spring.boot.FaceppOperations
com.faceplusplus.spring.boot.FaceppFacesetOperations
Direct Known Subclasses:
FaceppFacesetAsyncOperations
public class FaceppFacesetOperations extends FaceppOperations
Synchronous operations for FaceSet management, including create, delete, update, list, and face token add/remove operations, as well as face information management.
Since:
3.0.0
Author:
[@Loong Wan](https://github.com/loong10k)
